unsupported_candidate_fields_policy: Do not fabricate battery current, SOC, angular velocity, reaction wheel speed, or additional temperature channels not present in the simulator.

subsystem_ownership.battery_power: BAT-RB-001 owns battery voltage and battery temperature only when investigated in an electrical-power context (e.g., alongside battery_voltage changes).
subsystem_ownership.temperature_thermal: THM-RB-001 owns broader spacecraft thermal behaviour across components and thermal-control equipment.
subsystem_ownership.attitude_adcs: ATT-RB-001 owns spacecraft attitude and orientation telemetry (roll, pitch, yaw).

safety_rules: No autonomous spacecraft commands or control execution.
No invented universal engineering limits; mission limits must come from configured detector bounds or approved documentation.
No unsupported root-cause claims; present possible causes only.
Runbook recommendations must remain investigative and grounded in retrieved evidence.

runbooks.title: Attitude and Orientation Subsystem Troubleshooting Runbook
runbooks.ownership_scope: Owns attitude and orientation anomalies (roll, pitch, yaw).

runbooks.title: Temperature and Thermal Subsystem Troubleshooting Runbook
runbooks.ownership_scope: Owns broader spacecraft thermal behaviour and thermal-control component temperature checks.

runbooks.title: Battery and Power Subsystem Troubleshooting Runbook
runbooks.ownership_scope: Owns battery voltage and battery temperature only when investigated in an electrical-power context.
